GAMEPLAY_NightTerrorWakeup.English: You jolt awake in sheer panic, gripped by a night terror
GAMEPLAY_NightTerrorWakeup.French (France): Vous vous réveillez en sursaut, pris de panique, en proie à une terreur nocturne.
GAMEPLAY_NightTerrorWakeup.Spanish (Spain): Te despiertas sobresaltado, presa del pánico, presa de un terror nocturno
GAMEPLAY_NightTerrorWakeup.German: Du schreckst in blanker Panik auf, gepackt von einem Albtraum
GAMEPLAY_NightTerrorWakeup.Turkish: Bir gece kabusunun pençesine düşmüş, büyük bir panikle aniden uyanıyorsunuz
GAMEPLAY_NightTerrorWakeup.Russian: Вы резко просыпаетесь в состоянии паники, охваченные ночным кошмаром

GAMEPLAY_BadDreamWakeup.English: You wake up suddenly, shaken by a bad dream
GAMEPLAY_BadDreamWakeup.French (France): Vous vous réveillez brusquement, secoué par un mauvais rêve
GAMEPLAY_BadDreamWakeup.Spanish (Spain): Te despiertas de repente, sacudido por una mala pesadilla
GAMEPLAY_BadDreamWakeup.German: Du wachst plötzlich auf, erschüttert von einem Albtraum
GAMEPLAY_BadDreamWakeup.Turkish: Kötü bir rüyanın etkisiyle aniden uyanıyorsunuz
GAMEPLAY_BadDreamWakeup.Russian: Вы внезапно просыпаетесь, потрясенные кошмарным сном

GAMEPLAY_CantSleep.English: You are too shaken to fall back asleep
GAMEPLAY_CantSleep.French (France): Vous êtes trop secoué pour vous rendormir
GAMEPLAY_CantSleep.Spanish (Spain): Estás demasiado conmocionado para volver a dormirte
GAMEPLAY_CantSleep.German: Du bist zu erschüttert, um wieder einzuschlafen
GAMEPLAY_CantSleep.Turkish: O kadar sarsıldınız ki tekrar uyuyamıyorsunuz
GAMEPLAY_CantSleep.Russian: Вы слишком потрясены, чтобы снова заснуть

GAMEPLAY_SplinterDescription.English: A splinter is lodged in your skin.
GAMEPLAY_SplinterDescription.French (France): Une écharde est logée sous ta peau.
GAMEPLAY_SplinterDescription.Spanish (Spain): Una astilla se ha clavado en tu piel.
GAMEPLAY_SplinterDescription.German: Ein Splitter steckt in deiner Haut.

GAMEPLAY_SensitiveHandDescription.English: The splinter in your hand has caused irritation, your hand remains sensitive and easily irritated, making your actions more difficult.
GAMEPLAY_SensitiveHandDescription.French (France): L'écharde dans ta main a provoqué une irritation, ta main reste sensible et s'irrite facilement, rendant tes actions plus difficiles.
GAMEPLAY_SensitiveHandDescription.Spanish (Spain): La astilla en tu mano ha causado irritación; tu mano sigue sensible y se irrita con facilidad, lo que dificulta tus acciones.
GAMEPLAY_SensitiveHandDescription.German: Der Splitter in deiner Hand hat Reizungen verursacht; deine Hand bleibt empfindlich und entzündet sich leicht, was deine Handlungen erschwert.
GAMEPLAY_SensitiveHandDescription.Turkish: Elinizdeki kıymık tahrişe neden oldu; eliniz hassas kaldı ve kolayca tahriş oluyor, bu da eylemlerinizi zorlaştırıyor.
GAMEPLAY_SensitiveHandDescription.Russian: Заноза в руке вызвала раздражение: рука остаётся чувствительной и легко воспаляется, из-за чего работать сложнее.

GAMEPLAY_BlisterDescription.English: You have made a sustained effort for too long.
GAMEPLAY_BlisterDescription.French (France): Tu as fais un effort soutenu pendant trop longtemps.
GAMEPLAY_BlisterDescription.Spanish (Spain): Has hecho un esfuerzo prolongado durante demasiado tiempo.
GAMEPLAY_BlisterDescription.German: Du hast dich zu lange dauerhaft angestrengt.
GAMEPLAY_BlisterDescription.Turkish: Çok uzun süre sürekli efor sarf ettiniz.

GAMEPLAY_BareSkinDescription.English: Skin worn down by repeated friction becomes tender, making prolonged movement uncomfortable.
GAMEPLAY_BareSkinDescription.French (France): La peau, usée par des frottements répétés, devient à vif, rendant les déplacements prolongés inconfortables.
GAMEPLAY_BareSkinDescription.Spanish (Spain): La piel, desgastada por la fricción repetida, se vuelve sensible, haciendo incómodo moverse durante mucho tiempo.
GAMEPLAY_BareSkinDescription.German: Durch wiederholte Reibung aufgescheuerte Haut wird empfindlich und macht längere Bewegungen unangenehm.
GAMEPLAY_BareSkinDescription.Turkish: Tekrarlayan sürtünmeyle aşınan cildiniz hassaslaşır; uzun süre hareket etmek rahatsız edici olur.
GAMEPLAY_BareSkinDescription.Russian: Кожа, натертая неоднократно, становится тонкой, доставляя дискомфорт при длительном движении.

GAMEPLAY_ScratchDescription.English: You've scratched your skin, nothing too serious...
GAMEPLAY_ScratchDescription.French (France): Tu a égratigné ta peau, rien de trop sérieux...
GAMEPLAY_ScratchDescription.Spanish (Spain): Te has arañado la piel, nada demasiado serio...
GAMEPLAY_ScratchDescription.German: Du hast dir die Haut aufgeschürft, nichts allzu Ernstes...
GAMEPLAY_ScratchDescription.Turkish: Cildinizi sıyırdınız, çok da ciddi değil...

GAMEPLAY_SmallCutDescription.English: A superficial scratch has opened slightly, requiring attention to prevent further complications.
GAMEPLAY_SmallCutDescription.French (France): Une égratignure superficielle s'est légèrement ouverte, nécessitant des soins pour éviter des complications.
GAMEPLAY_SmallCutDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un arañazo superficial se ha abierto un poco; requiere atención para evitar complicaciones.
GAMEPLAY_SmallCutDescription.German: Eine oberflächliche Schramme hat sich leicht geöffnet und braucht Pflege, um weitere Komplikationen zu vermeiden.
GAMEPLAY_SmallCutDescription.Turkish: Yüzeysel bir sıyrık biraz açıldı; daha fazla sorun yaşamamak için ilgilenmeniz gerekiyor.
GAMEPLAY_SmallCutDescription.Russian: Поверхностная царапина немного разошлась, наблюдайте за ней, чтобы избежать осложнений.

GAMEPLAY_StuckFoodDescription.English: It seems that some food is stuck between your teeth, and that's terribly annoying !
GAMEPLAY_StuckFoodDescription.French (France): Il semblerait que de la nourriture se soit bloquée entre tes dents, et c'est terriblement ennuyant !
GAMEPLAY_StuckFoodDescription.Spanish (Spain): Parece que se te ha quedado comida entre los dientes, ¡y es terriblemente molesto !
GAMEPLAY_StuckFoodDescription.German: Es scheint, als hätte sich Essen zwischen deinen Zähnen festgesetzt, und das ist furchtbar nervig !
GAMEPLAY_StuckFoodDescription.Turkish: Dişlerinizin arasına yiyecek sıkışmış gibi görünüyor ve bu inanılmaz derecede sinir bozucu !
GAMEPLAY_StuckFoodDescription.Russian: Похоже, еда застряла между зубами — и это ужасно раздражает !

GAMEPLAY_BackPainCause.French (France): Un sac à dos trop lourd

GAMEPLAY_BackPainDescription.English: Being encumbered for too long has consequences...
GAMEPLAY_BackPainDescription.French (France): Être encombré pendant trop longtemps a des conséquences...
GAMEPLAY_BackPainDescription.Spanish (Spain): Estar demasiado cargado durante mucho tiempo tiene consecuencias...
GAMEPLAY_BackPainDescription.German: Zu lange überlastet zu sein hat Folgen...
GAMEPLAY_BackPainDescription.Turkish: Çok uzun süre aşırı yüklü kalmanın sonuçları olur...
GAMEPLAY_BackPainDescription.Russian: Последствия того, что вы тащили тяжелый вес слишком долго...

GAMEPLAY_BadDreamDescription.English: A disturbing dream snaps you awake, your throughts racing and sleep refusing to return.
GAMEPLAY_BadDreamDescription.French (France): Un mauvais rêve vous réveille en sursant, vos pensées s'emballent et le sommeil refuse de revenir.
GAMEPLAY_BadDreamDescription.Spanish (Spain): Un sueño inquietante te despierta de golpe; tus pensamientos se aceleran y el sueño se niega a volver.
GAMEPLAY_BadDreamDescription.German: Ein verstörender Traum reißt dich aus dem Schlaf; deine Gedanken rasen und der Schlaf will nicht zurückkehren.
GAMEPLAY_BadDreamDescription.Turkish: Rahatsız edici bir rüya sizi aniden uyandırır; düşünceleriniz yarışır ve uyku geri gelmez.
GAMEPLAY_BadDreamDescription.Russian: Страшный сон резко будит вас: мысли крутятся в голове, и сон никак не возвращается.

GAMEPLAY_NightTerrorDescription.English: You woke in intense panic, heart racing and mind clouded. The lingering fear makes it hard to calm down and regain your composure.
GAMEPLAY_NightTerrorDescription.French (France): Tu t'es réveillé en panique intense, le cœur battant et l'esprit embrumé. La peur persistante rend difficile de te calmer et de reprendre tes esprits.
GAMEPLAY_NightTerrorDescription.Spanish (Spain): Te despertaste en un pánico intenso, con el corazón acelerado y la mente nublada. El miedo persistente dificulta calmarte y recuperar la compostura.
GAMEPLAY_NightTerrorDescription.German: Du bist in heftiger Panik aufgewacht, mit rasendem Herz und vernebeltem Kopf. Die anhaltende Angst macht es schwer, dich zu beruhigen und dich wieder zu fangen.
GAMEPLAY_NightTerrorDescription.Turkish: Yoğun bir panikle uyandınız; kalbiniz hızla çarpıyor, zihniniz bulanık. Süren korku, sakinleşmenizi ve kendinize gelmenizi zorlaştırıyor.
GAMEPLAY_NightTerrorDescription.Russian: Вы проснулись в сильной панике: сердце колотится, в голове туман. Оставшийся страх мешает успокоиться и прийти в себя.

GAMEPLAY_WristTraumaDescription.English: The recoil hurt your wrist. Aiming and handling the weapon is more difficult.
GAMEPLAY_WristTraumaDescription.French (France): Le recul a blessé ton poignet. Viser et manipuler l'arme est plus difficile.
GAMEPLAY_WristTraumaDescription.Spanish (Spain): El retroceso te ha lesionado la muñeca. Apuntar y manejar el arma es más difícil.
GAMEPLAY_WristTraumaDescription.German: Der Rückstoß hat dein Handgelenk verletzt. Zielen und das Handling der Waffe sind schwieriger.
GAMEPLAY_WristTraumaDescription.Turkish: Geri tepme bileğinizi incitti. Nişan almak ve silahı kullanmak daha zor.
GAMEPLAY_WristTraumaDescription.Russian: Отдача повредила запястье. Целиться и обращаться с оружием стало сложнее.

GAMEPLAY_ShoulderTraumaDescription.English: The recoil hurt your shoulder. Aiming and handling the weapon is more difficult.
GAMEPLAY_ShoulderTraumaDescription.French (France): Le recul a blessé ton épaule. Viser et manipuler l'arme est plus difficile.
GAMEPLAY_ShoulderTraumaDescription.Spanish (Spain): El retroceso te ha lesionado el hombro. Apuntar y manejar el arma es más difícil.
GAMEPLAY_ShoulderTraumaDescription.German: Der Rückstoß hat deine Schulter verletzt. Zielen und das Handling der Waffe sind schwieriger.
GAMEPLAY_ShoulderTraumaDescription.Turkish: Geri tepme omzunuzu incitti. Nişan almak ve silahı kullanmak daha zor.
GAMEPLAY_ShoulderTraumaDescription.Russian: Отдача повредила плечо. Целиться и обращаться с оружием стало сложнее.

GAMEPLAY_SoreNeckDescription.English: You slept in a very uncomfortable position, your neck is aching terribly.
GAMEPLAY_SoreNeckDescription.Turkish: Çok rahatsız bir pozisyonda uyudun, boynun çok ağrıyor.

GAMEPLAY_OverconfidenceRiskDescription.English: Everything seems so simple, doesn't it ?
GAMEPLAY_OverconfidenceRiskDescription.French (France): Tout semble si simple, n'est-ce pas ?
GAMEPLAY_OverconfidenceRiskDescription.Turkish: Her şey çok basit görünüyor, değil mi ?
GAMEPLAY_OverconfidenceRiskDescription.Russian: Всё кажется таким простым, не так ли ?

GAMEPLAY_OverconfidenceDescription.English: You are far too confident, you are paying the price for your experience, and you take your survival for granted. Afflictions are now easier to contract.
GAMEPLAY_OverconfidenceDescription.French (France): Tu es bien trop confiant, tu payes le prix de ton expérience et tiens ta survie pour acquise. Les maladies sont désormais plus faciles à contracter.
GAMEPLAY_OverconfidenceDescription.Spanish (Spain): Eres demasiado confiado, pagas el precio de tu experiencia y das tu supervivencia por hecha. Ahora es más fácil contraer aflicciones.
GAMEPLAY_OverconfidenceDescription.German: Du bist viel zu selbstsicher, Du zahlst den Preis deiner Erfahrung und nimmst dein Überleben als selbstverständlich. Leiden lassen sich nun leichter zuziehen.
GAMEPLAY_OverconfidenceDescription.Turkish: Fazlasıyla kendinize güveniyorsunuz, tecrübenizin bedelini ödüyor ve hayatta kalmanızı garanti görüyorsunuz. Artık rahatsızlıkları kapmak daha kolay.
GAMEPLAY_OverconfidenceDescription.Russian: Вы слишком самоуверенны, вы платите цену за свой опыт и воспринимаете выживание как должное. Теперь недуги подхватить проще.

GAMEPLAY_BareSkinInfection.Spanish (Spain): Piel en carne viva sin tratar

GAMEPLAY_ProtectedHandsDescription.English: Your gloves protect your hands against splinters while breaking down objects.
GAMEPLAY_ProtectedHandsDescription.French (France): Vos gants protègent vos mains contre les échardes lorsque vous démontez des objets.
GAMEPLAY_ProtectedHandsDescription.Spanish (Spain): Tus guantes protegen tus manos de las astillas al desmantelar objetos.
GAMEPLAY_ProtectedHandsDescription.German: Deine Handschuhe schützen deine Hände beim Zerlegen von Gegenständen vor Splittern.
GAMEPLAY_ProtectedHandsDescription.Turkish: Eldivenlerin, eşyaları sökerken ellerini kıymıklara karşı korur.
GAMEPLAY_ProtectedHandsDescription.Russian: Ваши перчатки защищают руки от заноз при разборке предметов.

GAMEPLAY_PeaceOfMindDescription.English: Time has passed since your last wildlife attack, and a restful sleep has calmed your nerves. Bad Dreams and Night Terrors can no longer occur.
GAMEPLAY_PeaceOfMindDescription.French (France): Le temps a passé depuis votre dernière attaque d'animal sauvage, et un sommeil réparateur a apaisé vos nerfs. Les mauvais rêves et les terreurs nocturnes ne peuvent plus survenir.
GAMEPLAY_PeaceOfMindDescription.Spanish (Spain): Ha pasado tiempo desde tu último ataque de fauna salvaje y un sueño reparador ha calmado tus nervios. Ya no pueden producirse malos sueños ni terrores nocturnos.
GAMEPLAY_PeaceOfMindDescription.German: Seit deinem letzten Angriff durch ein Wildtier ist einige Zeit vergangen, und erholsamer Schlaf hat deine Nerven beruhigt. Schlechte Träume und Nachtängste können nicht mehr auftreten.
GAMEPLAY_PeaceOfMindDescription.Turkish: Son vahşi hayvan saldırısından bu yana zaman geçti ve dinlendirici bir uyku sinirlerini yatıştırdı. Artık Kötü Rüyalar ve Gece Terörleri meydana gelemez.
GAMEPLAY_PeaceOfMindDescription.Russian: С момента последнего нападения дикого животного прошло достаточно времени, а спокойный сон успокоил ваши нервы. Кошмары и ночные ужасы больше не возникнут.

GAMEPLAY_ProtectedArmsDescription.English: Your clothing protects your arms from scratches while crafting items.
GAMEPLAY_ProtectedArmsDescription.French (France): Vos vêtements protègent vos bras des égratignures lorsque vous fabriquez des objets.
GAMEPLAY_ProtectedArmsDescription.Spanish (Spain): Tu ropa protege tus brazos de los arañazos mientras fabricas objetos.
GAMEPLAY_ProtectedArmsDescription.German: Deine Kleidung schützt deine Arme beim Herstellen von Gegenständen vor Kratzern.
GAMEPLAY_ProtectedArmsDescription.Turkish: Giysilerin, eşya üretirken kollarını çizilmelere karşı korur.
GAMEPLAY_ProtectedArmsDescription.Russian: Ваша одежда защищает руки от царапин при изготовлении предметов.
